description: This Java class serves as a REST controller for managing customer policies within an insurance management system. It provides endpoints for purchasing, canceling, and listing customer policies, utilizing Spring Boot annotations for web handling and security.

classes.name: CustomerPolicyController
classes.description: Spring REST Controller for managing customer policies, providing endpoints for purchase, cancellation, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to purchase a new customer policy.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to cancel an existing customer policy by ID.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all policies associated with a specific customer.
